global_music_identity.name: sweetness_features
global_music_identity.description: All generated music should keep ChewTune's sweet taste cues: relatively high pitch, bright but non-harsh timbre, consonant harmony, pleasant contour, and comfortable loopability. The background stem is the only exception: it is a sustained intervention tone for cpm_too_fast and may carry mild non-harsh tension.

music_preference.foreground_activity: 0 means Low Presence, 1 means Active / Foreground

intervention_goal.target_cpm: target chewing pace used by master_spec and runtime policy
intervention_goal.training_goal: used by playback policy and real-time state strategy, not by music preference weights

smooth_clear.description: 0 means smooth, connected, rounded and blended; 1 means clear, articulated, well-defined and crisp.

foreground_activity.description: 0 means lower presence and lower attention demand; 1 means more foreground, active, melodic and rhythmically present. The internal backgroundness weight also controls how perceivable the cpm_too_fast sustained intervention tone can become.

weight_formula.note: These weights do not directly generate music. They influence prompt word ratios and master specification sampling probabilities.

parameter_mapping.generation_seed: stored seeded random value for reproducible master specification sampling
parameter_mapping.master_logic: constrained weighted sampling from safe musical option pools
parameter_mapping.key: random sample from safe major keys, softly biased by clear_bias on the Smooth-Clear axis
parameter_mapping.scale: derived from tonic and sampled pleasant mode
parameter_mapping.mode: weighted sample from major, major pentatonic, lydian-inflected major
parameter_mapping.chord_progression: weighted sample from consonant roman progressions with clear_bias and active_bias, then normalized to sampled key
parameter_mapping.harmonic_rhythm: weighted sample; backgroundness favors slower harmonic rhythm for the harmonic stems
parameter_mapping.drum_pattern: soft sparse pulse with clear downbeat
parameter_mapping.percussion_timbre: clarity > 0.68 ? soft clear taps : rounded muted soft taps

runtime_strategy.cue_source: independent cue_library.json with soft_pop and soft_ding
runtime_strategy.retry_fallback: retry failed stems first; fallback to nearest approved library item or default safe silence with a low-volume cue
